summary: Iteration 4 testing of Studio Voxel CMS — Contact Inbox, MediaPicker, public draft filtering, and Journal/Gallery category filters. Backend: 3/3 new pytest cases pass (drafts hidden from public /api/blog but visible with include_drafts+auth; contact-submissions GET/PUT/DELETE with 401/404/422 handling; dashboard.unread_contacts increments after a new /contact POST). Frontend: /gallery category chips (All + 3 categories) filter items correctly; /blog tag chips (All notes + 5 tags) filter posts; admin sidebar shows Inbox nav link with unread badge (initially '3'); dashboard-inbox-banner renders and links to /admin/inbox; /admin/inbox master-detail shell renders with the 4 filter chips (all/unread/read/archived), enquiry list, and detail pane; clicking an unread enquiry auto-marks it read (badge dropped 3→2, unread count 3→2) and reveals Reply/Mark as read/Archive/Delete actions with expected data-testids; MediaPicker opens over the admin CRUD modal (z-index correct), lists uploads, and populates image_url + preview thumbnail; admin Journal list continues to use include_drafts=true (all currently 'Live' because no draft posts exist post-cleanup).

issues: Only one uploaded media asset (qa.png) exists in the seed and it renders as a broken image in the picker grid because the image data is not a valid PNG. Uploading a real image resolves it; consider seeding a valid sample or improving broken-image fallback.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 741 lines with heavy repetition across 7 CRUD resources — worth extracting a generic CRUD factory to reduce duplication before adding more collections.

GET /api/blog uses optional_admin dependency which parses cookies/tokens on every anonymous public request; consider caching the negative-auth path or short-circuiting when no Authorization header/cookie is present to reduce overhead on the highest-traffic public endpoint.

ContactStatusPayload uses regex validation — good, but the PUT endpoint returns clean_doc({**result, **data}) which relies on find_one_and_update return_document=AFTER semantics; the current pymongo return_document=True is truthy but not the enum ReturnDocument.AFTER — verify updated status is actually returned (it does in the test, so likely fine, but fragile).

AdminLayout polls /api/dashboard every 60s + on every route change to refresh the unread badge; this pulls full dashboard stats (project list, all counts) — a dedicated lightweight /api/inbox/unread-count endpoint would be cheaper and avoid coupling the badge to the dashboard payload.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test creates a draft blog post + two contact submissions and cleans them up in the same test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend endpoints: GET/PUT/DELETE /api/contact-submissions (admin auth). GET /api/blog now filters by active+published unless include_drafts=true AND admin cookie/bearer present. Dashboard stats include contact_submissions + unread_contacts. Frontend testids of note: gallery-filter-chips, blog-filter-chips, admin-inbox-nav-link, admin-inbox-badge, admin-inbox-shell, admin-inbox-filter-{all|unread|read|archived}, admin-inbox-open-{n}, admin-inbox-reply-link, admin-inbox-mark-read/-mark-unread/-archive/-delete, dashboard-inbox-banner, admin-{collection}-image_url-picker, media-picker-modal, media-picker-item-{n}, field-image-preview img. AdminCrud fetches blog with include_drafts=true so admin sees drafts; blog table status column shows 'Draft'/'Hidden'/'Live'. Backend has 3 seeded blog posts (all published) and multiple test contact submissions with mixed statuses.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects encountered in the four new features.
